Broadcom (AVGO) Lands $200 Billion Samsung AI Chip Deal Through 2030
items.summary: Samsung and Broadcom (NasdaqGS:AVGO) agreed a more than US$200b AI semiconductor deal running through 2030. The agreement focuses on next generation AI infrastructure, advanced memory and high performance computing chips. The multi year supply and co development deal deepens Broadcom's role in core AI hardware across data centers and related infrastructure.
